author: netanyahu
text:
Thank you, Prime Minister @JJansaSDS , for your friendship and steadfast support for Israel. 🇮🇱🇸🇮 

It was great meeting with you at the UN. 

Israel and Slovenia are opening a new chapter in our relations, strengthening cooperation in technology, tourism, AI, security, research and investment. 

Together, we will turn our strong friendship into concrete opportunities for both our peoples. I look forward to seeing you soon in Jerusalem.

Thank you, Prime Minister @JJansaSDS
